lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-intensity circular spots are distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills, with the spots in the central row exhibiting the greatest diameter and luminance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: A series of vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a regular grid where the primary circular blobs act as anchor nodes within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge extends horizontally across the dorsal-lateral interface, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring highlights on the upper surface and a shadow cast on the lower surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A clear indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing margin of the pectoral fin silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit displays a high density of small, high-frequency white points, contrasting with the larger, more structured grid-based pattern on the lateral flank.
